attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 20, `ampG` to `nrdR`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 0.4% of calls. The model names 87 to 100% of them, fewest at column 6, `yajR`, 87%.

**A single variable column follows**, column 21, `yajI`, carried by 88%. The spine resumes at columns 22 to 39, `tsx` to `rdgC`, and columns 41 to 50, `ppnP` to `iraP`, both carried by 92 to 95%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 92%, and hesitates less there, 0.17 against 0.53 bits. Its most hesitant column, 66, `yaiP`, is a variable column, at 1.22 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 73 to 79, `mhpT` to `mhpA`, are carried by 46 to 80% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 58 to 86% of calls. The last column is `mhpA`, in 46% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 96% of genes**, 0.24 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.70 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 90% against 97%.

label: ampG
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ampG window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ampG, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,280 to 3,359 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ampG once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 96% of genes, 0.24 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,130 calls, named 99%, 0.11 bits; shell 7,922 calls, named 84%, 0.79 bits; cloud 68 calls, named 0%, 4.02 bits. Outside an RGP 37,466 calls, named 97%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 5,654 calls, named 90%, 0.70 bits. Columns: 63 spine, 5 fork, 12 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.70 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (90% against 97%); 5,654 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 66 (yaiP, a variable column) 1.22 bits, RGP 69%; column 65 ("protein YkiC", a fork column) 1.12 bits, RGP 64%; column 67 ("acetyltransferase", a variable column) 1.06 bits, RGP 74%. The 12 columns (columns 64-68 and 73-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 93%, 0.53 bits on average; the other 68 columns: named 96%, 0.19 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 63 spine columns: named 97%, 0.17 bits on average; the 17 fork and variable columns: named 92%, 0.53 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 66, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 73-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 58-86%; the least: columns 0-20 (spine), RGP 0-0.4%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-20 (21 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-0.4%. Genes: ampG, cyoA, cyoB "cytochrome o ubiquinol oxidase subu…", cyoC, cyoD, cyoE, yajR "MFS transporter", yajQ "nucleotide binding protein YajQ", panE, yajL "protein deglycase YajL", thiI, xseB, ispA, dxs, yajO "1-deoxyxylulose-5-phosphate synthas…", pgpA, thiL, nusB, ribH, ribD "bifunctional diaminohydroxyphosphor…", nrdR. named 87-100% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6 (yajR), named 87%, 0.74 bits.
[S2] 2. column 21 variable: share 88%, all P, RGP 1%. named 99%; 0.17 bits.
[S2.c21]    21: yajI P 88% "DUF3251 domain-containing protein"
[S3] 3. columns 22-39 (18 columns) spine: share 92-95%, all P, RGP 0.4-1%. Genes: tsx, yajD "HNH nuclease YajD", secF "protein translocase subunit SecF", secD, yajC "preprotein translocase subunit YajC", tgt, queA, acpH, malZ, proY, brnQ, phoR "phosphate regulon sensor histidine…", phoB, sbcD "exonuclease subunit SbcD", sbcC, araJ, mak, rdgC. named 96-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 22 (tsx), named 96%; most hesitant at column 30 (malZ), 0.23 bits.
[S4] 4. column 40 variable: share 82%, all S, RGP 0.4%. named 98%; 0.71 bits.
[S4.c40]    40: "protein YkiD" S 82%
[S5] 5. columns 41-50 (10 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 0.4-1%. Genes: ppnP, aroM, yaiA "protein YaiA", aroL, yaiI "YaiI/YqxD family protein", proC, adrA, psiF, phoA, iraP. named 95-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 42 (aroM), named 95%; most hesitant at column 43 (yaiA), 0.27 bits.
[S6] 6. column 51 variable: share 75%, all S, RGP 1%. named 94%; 0.39 bits.
[S6.c51]    51: "hypothetical protein" S 75%
[S7] 7. columns 52-57 (6 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 1-2%. Genes: ddlA, yaiZ "DUF2754 domain-containing protein", yaiY "YaiY family protein", yaiW "surface-exposed outer membrane lipo…", sbmA, ampH. named 96-98% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 57 (ampH), named 96%, 0.25 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 58-59 (2 columns) fork: share 44-89%, 1 P, 1 S, RGP 2%. named 71-88% (mean 80%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 59, named 71%, 0.93 bits.
[S8.c58]    58: iprA P 89%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 20%
[S8.c59]    59: "autotransporter outer membrane beta-bar…" S 44%; also ehaB S 28%, "IS3 family transposase" S 14%
[S9] 9. columns 60-63 (4 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 3-20%. Genes: hemB, tauD, tauC "taurine ABC transporter permease Ta…", tauB. named 87-92% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 60 (hemB), named 87%, 0.38 bits.
[S10] 10. columns 64-68 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: share 60-88%, all S, RGP 51-74%. named 83-93% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 65, named 83%; most hesitant at column 66, 1.22 bits.
[S10.c64]    64 variable: tauA S 88%
[S10.c65]    65 fork: "protein YkiC" S 60%; also "PIG-L deacetylase family protein" S 17%
[S10.c66]    66 variable: yaiP S 76% "glycosyltransferase"
[S10.c67]    67 variable: "acetyltransferase" S 78%
[S10.c68]    68 variable: yaiO S 78% "YaiO family outer membrane beta-bar…"
[S11] 11. columns 69-72 (4 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 29-40%. Genes: frmR, frmA "S-(hydroxymethyl)glutathione dehydr…", fghA, yaiL "DUF2058 domain-containing protein". named 94-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 69 (frmR), named 94%, 0.43 bits.
[S12] 12. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: share 46-80%, all S, RGP 58-86%. named 94-97% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 73, named 94%, 0.29 bits.
[S12.c73]    73 fork: mhpT S 79%; also lacZ P 13%
[S12.c74-78]    columns 74-78 variable, share 60-80%, all S: mhpE 80%, mhpF 76%, mhpD 72%, mhpC 65%, mhpB 60%
[S12.c79]    79 fork: mhpA S 46% "bifunctional 3-(3-hydroxy-phenyl)pr…"; also mhpR S 22%
[Q] GROUPS whose products agree, the places for a [[ ]] (name that group's columns exactly, cite its line and [Q], make one phrase from its words): columns 1-5 (cyoA to cyoE) [S1]: cytochrome, oxidase, ubiquinol; columns 13-16 (dxs to thiL) [S1]: phosphate, synthase; columns 61-64 (tauD to tauA) [S9, S10]: taurine, transporter; columns 73-79 (mhpT to mhpA) [S12]: hydroxy.
